items.title: Keep feedback drafts visible when browser persistence fails
items.premise: Make optional feedback cadence reads and writes safe. Require an actual receipt writer for successful saving. Catch save failure in the contextual prompt, retain the draft and show an accessible retry message; never invoke onSaved or mark completed after a failed save. Test denied reads, quota failure and a successful retry in both themes and desktop/mobile.

rejectedOnVerify.premise: The game lacks a long-term loop.
rejectedOnVerify.evidence: context/GAME_LOOP.md and seasonChapters already define four decision horizons; repair optional panels before new breadth.
returnDigest derives only real state deltas; artificial absence rewards violate the existing evidence contract.

rejectedOnVerify.premise: External inference is needed to explain storage faults.
rejectedOnVerify.evidence: These are deterministic browser exceptions; local recovery and explicit messages suffice.

rejectedOnVerify.premise: A dependency is required for safe property access.
rejectedOnVerify.evidence: gistCredentials already uses a small guarded accessor; no package or download is necessary.

rejectedOnVerify.premise: Caching inference would reduce these failures.
rejectedOnVerify.evidence: The affected modules perform no model calls; measured inference savings would be zero.

rejectedOnVerify.premise: Run the sibling start-sync to repair a missing local tool.
rejectedOnVerify.evidence: scripts/start-sync.mjs is absent and owner-rooted scripts measure the wrong repository; clean local fetch and zero divergence were verified instead.
